evidenceScoring.missing: Declared profile weights remain fixed; unknown components produce an unresolved input range.
evidenceScoring.semantics: Observed access replaces health outcomes; cost, service and demographic proxies cannot masquerade as profile-specific evidence.
evidenceScoring.status: 2.15.16: prepared, not live. Fixed weights with unresolved ranges fail the external-benchmark and plausibility audits (fDi 68/80, profile audit 35 weak top-10 needs vs limit 15); switch on after the evidence acquisitions.

young_family.requirements: Moves and retention of households with children, childcare coverage and cost, actual school access and housing burden.

low_income.requirements: Residual household resources after a fixed essential basket, access to suitable jobs without a car, retention and hardship outcomes.

low_income_family.requirements: Fixed two-adult low-income family scenario, with child costs and employment access measured separately.

single_parent.requirements: Single-parent retention, childcare affordability and hours compatible with work, short reliable journeys and family-sized rentals.

pensioner.requirements: Age-specific domestic migration and retention, plus pension-budget affordability, accessible healthcare and independent-living outcomes. Separate age proxy from confirmed retirement.

single_pensioner.requirements: Older single-person household moves and retention; accessible housing, care and social participation.

early_retiree.requirements: Moves of non-employed adults below pension age where measurable; otherwise explicitly labelled age-based evidence, not retirement counts.

single.requirements: Single-adult housing affordability and retention, with career outcomes only for the career-oriented case.

young_professional.requirements: Age 25-39 employment and migration, occupation-specific wages net of housing, and career retention.

dinks.requirements: Dual-earner child-free household migration and net resources where microdata permit; never substitute all young adults.

remote.requirements: Remote-worker shares and persistence, verified home broadband reliability and cost, and residual budget.

commuter.requirements: Observed commuting flows and mode shares against scheduled and congestion-aware travel times.

car_free.requirements: Car-free household access to jobs, groceries and healthcare, including evenings, weekends and accessible routes.

student.requirements: Enrolment by actual teaching campus, student moves, accommodation burden and student transport access.

first_home.requirements: Ownership transitions and availability under a published standard financing and dwelling scenario, not house-price appreciation.

budget.requirements: Total essential expenditure and access to jobs/services under a fixed modest budget; compare with low_income for redundancy.

urban.requirements: Resident retention, actual cultural and service access, travel behaviour and net housing burden.

expat_professional.requirements: Skilled international arrivals and retention with a defined nationality/permit scenario; total foreign-born stock is not an annual flow.

healthcare_first.requirements: Access to appropriate care, capacity, out-of-pocket burden and avoidable admissions; never infer clinical quality from a nearby hospital alone.

nature.requirements: Accessible nature, air/water quality, ecological conditions and services, with household moves only as secondary evidence.

rural_value.requirements: Rural retention, accessible services and broadband, local job reach and total transport-adjusted costs.

hnw.requirements: Official residence/tax cases and persistent high-value services; avoid opaque millionaire-migration estimates.

swiss_lottery.requirements: Use an explicitly defined wealth scenario and official municipal tax calculations, not an invented lottery-winner behavioural model.

climate.requirements: Historical and forward-looking hazard exposure, insurance availability, adaptation and service continuity; migration alone cannot certify resilience.

coastal.requirements: Observed coastal household attraction and retention, public shoreline access and seasonal costs, separately from insurance/hazard risks.

business_owner.requirements: Owner-manager residence outcomes plus access to the relevant enterprise network; no company feasibility claim from this household score.

digital_native.requirements: Define digital occupation/working arrangement; otherwise compare redundancy and merge with a career or remote-work profile.

outdoor.requirements: Actual public activity access, terrain suitability and safety, including non-mountain outdoor destinations.

cross_border.requirements: Official cross-border commuting flows, crossing schedules and a fixed residence/work/tax/social-insurance case.

sun_retiree.requirements: Older foreign-resident inflows and retention under a published origin/permit case, not holiday nights or expat stock alone.

biz_manufacturing.requirements: Sector-specific establishment openings, employment and survival, matched to operating-site capacity and logistics.

biz_logistics.requirements: Warehouse/transport employment and openings, freight throughput, shipment time and delivery-market access.

biz_tech.requirements: Software employment and wages, business births/survival and skilled-worker retention; separate lagged ecosystem inputs from future outcomes.

biz_services.requirements: Back-office establishment activity and retention, occupation-specific labour availability and wage/productivity measures.

biz_lab.requirements: Field-specific R&D employment, operating laboratories, research outputs and spinout survival.

biz_hq.requirements: Actual regional HQ employment and relocations, route/time-zone access and the relevant legal/tax operating scenario.

biz_port_industry.requirements: Cargo-specific throughput, port industrial employment and operating investment, with actual terminal links.

biz_shop.requirements: Retail establishment survival, expenditure and pedestrian catchment; compare like store types.

biz_cafe.requirements: Food-service openings/survival, time-of-day footfall, tourism/daytime workers and comparable rents.

biz_workshop.requirements: Trade-specific business activity, survival and demand in a drive-time catchment.

biz_practice.requirements: Unmet care demand, reimbursement, staffing, patient access and practice survival.

biz_studio.requirements: Creative-sector employment, business survival and project/commission demand.

biz_startup.requirements: Sector-specific new employer firms, survival, scaled employment and verified financing, with non-employer shells separated.

biz_guesthouse.requirements: Official guest nights, occupancy and seasonality, lodging supply and business survival.

biz_energy_intensive.requirements: Operating sector capacity and realised investment, industrial tariffs, firm grid access and utility reliability.

biz_datacenter.requirements: Operational commissioned MW and occupancy, enterprise fibre and actual grid connection lead time; announced projects are a separate series.

biz_pharma_production.requirements: Authorised operating production sites, specialist employment and realised capacity, not patents or lab counts alone.

biz_food_processing.requirements: Operating food plants, agricultural input access, employment and throughput.

biz_fulfilment.requirements: Fulfilment operations, last-mile delivery coverage and workforce availability.

biz_contact_center.requirements: Contact-centre employment and retention, verified language pools and wage/turnover costs.

biz_bank.requirements: Licensed banking establishments and jobs, client market and operating permissions.

biz_wealth.requirements: Official wealth-management employment/authorised entities and client reach; private wealth estimates require a clear licence and method.

biz_broker.requirements: Authorised securities firms, market connectivity and specialist employment.

biz_insurer.requirements: Licensed insurers, actuarial/underwriting employment, market access and operating substance.

biz_fund.requirements: Regulated fund management and administration activity, separated from legal domiciles and assets booked there.

biz_commodity.requirements: Commodity trading employment and regulated/registered operating entities; cargo terminals only for physical operations.

biz_crypto.requirements: Authorised virtual-asset service activity and employment, not token prices, promotional rankings or corporate registrations alone.

biz_swf.requirements: Only compare optional investment-office locations under a declared mandate, not sovereign fund domiciles.

biz_finance.requirements: Finance employment and operating entities by subsector, plus role-specific authorisation and substance.

biz_semis.requirements: Operating fabs versus design offices versus assembly/test sites, with specialist staffing and realised capacity.

biz_auto.requirements: Automotive plants, suppliers, employment and realised expansions, using an explicit supplier tier and product case.

biz_aero.requirements: Aerospace operating sites, employment, certifications and supply-chain links.

biz_cleantech.requirements: Operational plants and realised capacity by product, with input materials, power and permitting.

biz_media.requirements: Media/games employment, commissioned production and business survival by subtype; announced projects are not operating activity.

biz_clinic.requirements: Unmet care demand, patient travel and payer coverage, authorisable capacity and clinical staffing, not population growth alone.

config.semanticIntegrityNote: 2.15.16: prepared, not live. With it on, mean evidence coverage falls to 59% (2,090 of 4,216 country-profile lists under 60%) and the external benchmarks and plausibility audits fail. Switch on per profile once the missing evidence (healthcare access, services, cohort migration) is acquired.

terms.coverage: Declared profile weights remain fixed. Missing inputs remain unresolved. Coverage is available weight, not statistical confidence.

softFloorsNote: 2.15.16 budget reality: retirees live on a fixed income, so housing markets scoring under 40 on affordability lose half a point per missing point, in every country (before: only Swiss floors). Removes San Francisco Bay Area suburbs from the US retiree top; Florida's first sun-retiree place moves from #257 to #20.

preparedCategoryLabels.focus: Activity-specific evidence available for this business
preparedCategoryLabels.climate: Climate preference proxy: class and winter daylight
preparedCategoryLabels.reach300: Population within 300 km straight-line, not truck travel time
preparedCategoryLabels.quiet: Measured nuisance components; missing components unresolved

preparedProfileIntros.pensioner: Healthcare access, recorded safety, housing cost and climate preference, with observed older-person migration shown separately.

preparedNote: 2.15.16: labels and intros that describe the prepared evidence model; they go live together with that model, not before (the live model still uses the 2.15.15 wording).
